mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_id, actor_username, tenant_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, detail, ip_address, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorId}, #{actorUsername}, #{tenantId}, #{action}, #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{detail}, #{ipAddress}, datetime('now'))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE actor_id = #{actorId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT * FROM audit_logs WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200
